reviews.review: i like it more than ror2

this game ♥♥♥♥♥. good soundtrack, good gameplay loop, solid learning curve for each character. tbf it needs more love. if you like good roguelikes and you want a fresh experience then this is your game, look no further

Always disliked timed things in variety of games, add that to rogue game and make it harder as time goes by.. oh boi. Still even with the frustrating game mechanic that makes you rush with garbage levels of mobility, Risk of Rain does it's stuff fairly well.

Mobility is really the main issue with the game, only few characters have bit better movement and most of them move pretty slowly, add platforms and low mobility along with quite bad base jump. Going around the levels is very slow and is forced even slower with 90 sec survival timer for portal in five levels total along with needing to kill every single spawned enemy otherwise can't progress, this only not being in final sixth level, that's totally another survival with the last boss.

Basically what makes you survive is the items and upgrades that give good boost to all around mobility and damage keening on what you find. Also getting them unlocked first is thing to do along with getting other characters beside standard commando, which actually isn't the worst in roster, but still far from the best. Acrid from level 3, Engineer, Loader and Huntress (rng logs to open) felt easily best among the roster that had open, only three were missing in the end that stopped playing. There are utter garbage characters like Han-D which is mainly melee, but very slow and adding that to bad mobility is certain death sentence. It doesn't take too long to difficulty bar raise to a medium difficulty at 9 minutes, when playing on standard setting of rainstorm and that's when some teleporting enemies start to spawn at last. Which mean on top of having bad mobility, you have enemies very likely spawning on you and doing massive damage fast, as they very easily gang up on you, if damage numbers aren't high enough. Character levels come to halt around level 13, when it becomes very slow to go up anymore. Characters have all four skills that all do usually some way damage or give more mobility, but have cooldown to them besides the basic attack.

Due the mobility level design can be pretty bad, some section are long plains, other very much upgrades needing maneuvers and so on. Music is really great and think art style is quite fitting, though it can be hard to see anything when you get ganged up or enemies teleport on you. Still it's most likely game over at that point. It's still enjoyable game, but feel that design really isn't too likable at few places.
I honestly dunno why I keep doing this to myself..
